テキスト cha 420: Born Shiyo 783, July 29. Height 161cm. A 2nd-year at Motoki High School. Her constitution breaks down in the cherry blossom season. Haruka Niimura, who lives next door, has been her one and only close friend since early childhood.
Bad with talk of horror and crime. She often leans on Haruka Niimura to be comforted over such things, and feels sorry about it all the time.
She has an odd ability to sense danger to people, but only in the cherry blossom season.

When her father Ryoji Kogori is killed she is shocked, yet she still looks after Haruka Niimura, who grieves as much as she does: timid as she is, she has a mental strength that does not lose sight of herself.
In Shiyo 788 Haruka's father, Eiichiro Niimura, fell from a tree and died while trying to get back a balloon she had let go, but she was small then and has no memory of it.
She should have come home from the police station, but she has become a beheaded body. Haruka Niimura touches the head and says "It is still warm", so she appears to have died only shortly before.

On Erina Goto's advice she makes a false telephone call to Haruka Niimura. That is not because she cannot trust Haruka Niimura but because she trusts Erina Goto, and she has not thrown away her faith in Haruka Niimura. Immediately afterward, though, she senses danger from a monstrous figure that appears out of nowhere, and is beheaded with nothing she can do.

When Haruka Niimura presses in with a terrible look and says that she killed Ryoji Kogori, she does not give a step and holds her ground. She says that if danger really is coming she wants to be protected, and so hardens Haruka Niimura's resolve.
Against a critically injured Haruka Niimura, Natsumi Kogori herself is unhurt. She is stunned out of her senses, however, and can say nothing, so what she saw is unknown.

Thinking that to prove Haruka Niimura innocent she must know about the case, she is shown Ryoji Kogori, now a flayed body. She faces a father no one could bear to look at straight on, and spends a while in bitter time with him.
She apologizes to Mifuyu Niimura for a past wrong, but is told that is not the whole of the problem, and has a deeper piece of reality thrust back at her.

シナリオ名: The Maidens' Holy War ~Demon of Fury~
テキスト cha 420: She seems to have a complex about her figure, and when mocked she flies into an uncontrollable rage. She likes ikura sushi.

In junior high she was in the volleyball club, and with Erina Goto's support she improved remarkably. Erina Goto is moved by the way she never gives up and keeps working, and comes to hold her in respect.

シナリオ名: Haruka and the Witch and the Shinigami
テキスト cha 420: In Shiyo 802 she was heading to the Arata settlement with Erina Goto to look for Haruka Niimura, who had gone missing. She had Erina Goto look into the Arata settlement and seems to know it is a dangerous place. Since the Motoki-cho incident her April sickness is in remission, though her ability to sense danger remains.
She goes alone to the convenience store for supplies and enjoys the walk, glad her April sickness has not flared up. She seems to have no premonition of danger.

Not even Haruka Niimura knew, but she has quite a gambler's streak. To get back at Erina Goto for mocking her figure, she proposes a Russian-roulette takoyaki match at Zahha, betting on posting their measurements, cup sizes and weights online.

シナリオ名: I'm the Type Who Looks Slimmer in Clothes
テキスト cha 420: She draws the Black Death Devil Pepper (BDDP for short) in Zahha's Russian-roulette takoyaki and takes enough damage to shut herself in the bathroom for dozens of minutes. Incidentally, BDDP's Scoville rating (a unit of spiciness) is 16 million Scoville. An ordinary person would die, so good children and bad children alike, do not try this.

シナリオ名: I'm the Type Who Looks Slimmer in Clothes
テキスト cha 420: To Natsumi Kogori, clothes are apparently something you can just take off when it comes to it.

Though told by Haruka Niimura of the death of her father, Ryoji Kogori, she understands it is information needed to prevent further tragedy, and cooperates fully. Haruka Niimura too praises the way she shows greater mental strength the more adverse things get.
新村春花にジャージを借りに行ったところ、偶然新村春花のクラスメイトである立野と出会う。以降、どういうわけか立野のキモキャラはすっかり鳴りを潜め、おしゃれで小奇麗な男子に生まれ変わったという。立野のその後の女性関係については定かではない。

On the last day of Golden Week she has begun a new life with Haruka Niimura. That night, however, in a season that should have no cherry blossom, she suddenly says something that can be taken for a foreseeing of danger.
Haruka Niimura's younger sister―born as her true sister.

In Shiyo 788 she saw Eiichiro Niimura's death before her eyes but could not understand what had happened. Right afterward she also made danger-sensing prophecies to Ryoji Kogori and Mifuyu Niimura, which made them suspect that some strange change had come over her.
Though troubled by April sickness since the accident in Shiyo 788, she safely started elementary school.
In first grade she had already met Erina Goto, but judging by the Jusatsu Arc and the Meicho Arc, apparently neither of them remembers it.

When they were going to Megasawa City at Mifuyu Niimura's call, she herself was to be left with her grandparents, but she held on, insisting that she too had to go to Megasawa City to help Haruka Niimura.

She reunites with Haruka and Mifuyu Niimura and shows her joy with her whole body. Mifuyu Niimura had been casting a look like hatred at Natsumi, but seeing her so innocently happy at the reunion, Mifuyu Niimura's expression softens, just a tiny bit.
She meets Erina Goto again at the zoo and tries to give her a matching phone strap, but the timing is bad and she cannot hand it over.
She says something to Ryoji Kogori to the effect of 'Don't get in Mifuyu Niimura's way.' Ryoji Kogori takes it as a kind of danger sense, but cannot confirm what it means.

The sole survivor of the murders Mifuyu Niimura committed at Nanami-so. But that day seems to have left a heavy burden on her mind: 10 years later, in Shiyo 800, she is in a hospital somewhere. Her April sickness has not gone into remission, and she tells eerie predictions to the people she meets.
怒りをあらわにした新村美冬に対して、新村春花のために怒りを収めるよう説得するも、それが逆に怒りを買ってメイスで撲殺されそうになる。しかし新村春花がなつみをかばい、その餌食となってしまった。

Learning the truth of why the Niimura family vanished from Motoki-cho, she faces Mifuyu Niimura head-on and apologizes for her mistake. Not giving an inch before Mifuyu Niimura's cold words, she comes to understand their hearts together with Haruka Niimura and Akane Kogori, and they reach true reconciliation.
After the matter in Megasawa City, she lives a life free of April sickness and seems able to enjoy spring and the cherry blossoms.
In the Jusatsu and Meicho Arcs, Mifuyu Niimura hated her one-sidedly for her 'witch's power,' but after they reconciled in Shiyo 790 they seem to have built an extremely good relationship.

Seeing the cherry tree at the Niimura main house, she feels a strange sense that something is off. It seems to be different from her danger sense, and she vaguely feels that the world and the Arata settlement differ in some way after all.
She was bewildered by the meal of nothing but weird food served at the Niimura main house, but once she tasted it, she was moved even more than by salmon-roe sushi.

She not only joins in the ghost stories on a whim but seems to have a fair stock of ghost-story material, so she appears to have some tolerance for horror. In that respect her personality differs slightly from the routes where the Megasawa City case occurs.
As she talks with Erika Niimura, they warm to each other and become friends.

She is attacked by a group in Noh masks that suddenly bursts into the Niimura main house, and dies. The motive is unknown. Just before, however, she feels something is off about Kotaro Niimura's words, "Sakura Niimura is dead."
At Arata Station, with her parents taken hostage, she rushes out in front of Kotaro Niimura, but is knocked unconscious by the residents. Kotaro Niimura called Natsumi Kogori a 'divine messenger.'
She originally planned to take the train from Toyotake Station to Arata Station, but the voice of danger sense tells her to "go with Kana Niimura."
She recognizes Chigaya Niimura as a kindred spirit with the same worries, and senses that they may know each other for a long time.

Riding on a buggy driven by Kengo Shirozaki, a settlement resident, she tries to casually draw him out about the ten years of cases, but he warns her "not to tell anyone in the settlement" about her danger sense.
She meant to have Mifuyu Niimura take her to where the cherry tree is, but fruitless circumstances leave no adult able to move, Mifuyu included, so she decides to negotiate with Kengo Shirozaki.
Kengo Shirozaki takes her to the convenience store, and during a call with Erina Goto she sees what seems to be danger sense. She warns Erina to get away from there at once.

Unsettled by Kengo Shirozaki's many ominous words, she threatens him with a knife to let her off the buggy at once. But she is told that this very distrust is what brings on the curse-killings, and reluctant to flee and leave Haruka Niimura and the others behind, she decides to go back to the settlement as she is.
She attends the thirteenth-year memorial service and somehow gets through every rite, but on returning to the Niimura main house she finds an eerie letter has been slipped into her clothes.

In the Abaddon Circle underground, she shields Haruka Niimura, who was about to take a slash from Kotaro Niimura. Just before, she was told that she and Haruka are real sisters, and as her consciousness fades she thinks she would have liked to enjoy life as sisters too.
Knocked out by Kotaro Niimura's attack, she meets Eiichiro Niimura while unconscious. Asked not to seek the truth and to stay with Haruka Niimura, she returns to the real world.

She was able to stop Kotaro Niimura's slash because she had the Grand Witch's Noh mask, given to her by Erika Niimura, tucked inside her clothes. The mask is made of hard metal; it saved her from instant death, but the impact was still considerable, and she was unconscious for some time.

In the open-air bath she meets a fortune-teller and has her future read, and is told that soon one of the people important to her will die. Separately, someone close to her will lose something important. Natsumi cannot guess what it means, but decides to keep it in mind.
Even now, as a second-year high school student, she still takes baths with her father, Ryoji Kogori, and until Haruka Niimura pointed it out, she believed it was the normal thing in every household.

Facing the mysteries left behind by the curse-killings, she follows the voice of Eiichiro Niimura and the voice of the fortune-teller she met at the inn, and decides not to chase the truth any further. Still, she does not try to stop Erina Goto, who keeps on seeking the truth, and cheers her on, telling her she can lean on her if things get hard.

シナリオ名: サード・ジェネレーション
テキスト cha 420: Beheaded by the strange figure in the Noh mask, she seemed to have died, but that was an illusion Erina Goto saw after touching a tiny amount of her blood and gaining danger sense for an instant. She desperately calls Erina back from the danger sense that had seized her mind, leading to Mifuyu Niimura's arrest.

Out of guilt she devotes herself to caring for Haruka Niimura until it wears down her body and mind, and she keeps imagining Haruka is waking. On realizing it, she vomits blood from a stomach ulcer. To cure the Green-Eye Curse-Killing Haruka contracts from that blood, she undergoes a 'blood exchange.' It ends Haruka's murderous intent; she loses her danger sense, but her April sickness goes into remission.

シナリオ名: パラサイト・プリズン
テキスト cha 420: Having lost her family, she goes on living alone in Motoki City. She tries to escape Motoki City with Akane Kogori, who comes to see her, but cannot abandon Haruka Niimura when she suddenly appears, and stays with her. In the end, Haruka catches her off guard and she dies. She is reborn as a divine messenger.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
テキスト cha 420: She comes to the Arata settlement on Haruka Niimura's trail. But she is abducted by Chigaya Niimura and the others, and once she reaches the settlement, the 'Blessing' starts to drive her strange. Mifuyu Niimura, disguised as the White Hannya, saves her and she comes back to her senses, but she is killed at the hands of the residents.

She heads for the Arata settlement to attend the thirteenth-year memorial service, but has heard of the curse-killings beforehand. Unsure whether to go on to such a dangerous place, she thinks of Haruka Niimura's and Erina Goto's safety and proposes turning back to Motoki-cho. But right after, as if in tune with the cherry tree that suddenly appears, she says there is no going back.

She starts to regret forcing a brave face and coming to the Arata settlement. She thought that if only she pushed herself, the others would not worry, but she tires of it and cries. Then Erika Niimura tells her, "Everyone knows the others are pushing themselves too, so it's all right to open up," and she calms down.

Firmly told by Erina Goto never to leave her room, she is at a loss, but hints from Ryoji and Akane Kogori make her realize that she must not know anything: if she learns something, it will reach Necro. From this she understands that what she can do is take in false information to deceive Necro and throw it into confusion.

For a time she means to feed false information to those around her to deceive Shigatsu Youka, but she comes to think that where hearts are already scattered and everyone distrusts each other, this will only make things worse. Supposing that Shigatsu Youka has already planned for false information, she decides instead that everyone should properly confirm each other's thoughts and situations.

シナリオ名: 死月妖花～希望(パンドラ)～
テキスト cha 420: Suddenly, cherry blossoms that should not exist burst into bloom all over the settlement. At the same time she receives voices from an unknown girl and from Eiichiro Niimura. She learns that Shigatsu Youka is at the summit, that Erina Goto has been taken hostage, and that Noh masks and red robes are needed.
糸の「元木町に行きたい」という願いを聞き、それならば一緒に来ないかと誘う。周囲には激しく反対されるが、五島絵梨奈の助力もあり、周囲の説得に成功する。糸はそのことに深く感謝し、ともに行こうとするも、死月妖花の前に夢は絶たれる。
糸の純粋な願いを知るが、その純粋さゆえに手段を見失い、いかに糸が愚行を重ねてきたかを訴える。糸にもそれは通じたようで、自身の血を使って第三世代を増やし、死月妖花を滅ぼすことに成功する。
転校してきた糸にそっくりな少女、後白河糸織に気に入られ、これから長い付き合いになるだろうと感じる。
